title: Other Hispanic Voices
welcome_lead: HL options include Isabel Allende, Borges, Vargas Llosa, Bolano. Each adds a layer to the Spanish-language canon.
meta_desc: Spanish HL Literature: Allende, Borges, Vargas Llosa.
final_note: El canon hispanico es plural y vivo.

concepts.def: Chilean novelist, La casa de los espiritus (1982).

walkthroughs.body_html: La casa de los espiritus blends magical realism with Chilean political history — Pinochet's coup as familial trauma.
Ficciones (1944), El Aleph (1949). Borges's stories are philosophical games — infinite libraries, doubled selves, total recall.
The 1960s saw Garcia Marquez, Cortazar, Fuentes, Vargas Llosa achieve global recognition. Spanish-language fiction entered world literature.
